title: Lease
description: One lease or space commitment of the venture (a lease under ASC 842 and IFRS 16; APQC 10.1.3, provide workspace and facilities), at assets/leases/<id>.json (route assets/leases/[id]): premises, coworking or equipment, with its term, rent, notice and renewal dates and the terms that are hard to exit (a personal guarantee, auto-renewal). It abstracts the signed document and never replaces it. Signing, renewing or giving notice is a person's decision. The assets function owns it, and only the assets agent (role assets-agent) or a person writes it (writer function in packages/naive/src/records/data-model.json).

id.description: The lease's id, the file name without .json

counterparty.description: The landlord, coworking operator or lessor

end.description: The last day of the current term, or null for month-to-month

escalation.description: How the rent rises, such as 3% each year

auto_renews.description: True when the term renews unless notice is given

notice_days.description: Days of notice the venture must give to end the lease or not renew it

break_clause.description: When and how the venture may end early, and at what cost

personal_guarantee.description: True when a founder personally guarantees the rent. Signing one is always a founder decision

insurance_required.description: Cover the lease requires the venture to hold

spend.description: The spend register line that pays the rent, by id (finance/spend/<id>)

document.description: Where the signed lease is kept

status.description: proposed waits on the founder's decision to sign
